features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Users can create new tasks with title and description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a new task so that I can track my work items.
As a user, I can add a description to my task so that I can remember important details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task list page, When I click create task and enter details, Then a new task appears in my list.
Given I create a task without a title, When I try to save, Then I see an error message requiring a title.

features.name: Task Completion
features.description: Users can mark tasks as complete to track progress.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.
As a user, I can see completed tasks separately so that I can review what I've accomplished.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have an incomplete task, When I click the complete button, Then the task is marked as complete with a timestamp.
Given I have a completed task, When I view my task list, Then completed tasks are visually distinguished from incomplete ones.

features.name: Task Deletion
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.
As a user, I can confirm deletion so that I don't accidentally remove important tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I select a task to delete, When I confirm the deletion, Then the task is permanently removed from my list.
Given I click delete on a task, When the confirmation dialog appears, Then I can cancel to keep the task.

features.name: Task List View
features.description: Users can view all their tasks in an organized list.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks in one place so that I can see what needs to be done.
As a user, I can filter tasks by status so that I can focus on incomplete items.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have multiple tasks, When I open the app, Then I see all tasks sorted by creation date.
Given I apply a filter, When I select incomplete tasks only, Then completed tasks are hidden from view.

relationships.notes: Each task belongs to one user

assumptions: Users must be authenticated to access their tasks
Tasks are soft-deleted or permanently removed based on business requirements
Task completion is tracked with timestamp for analytics
Each user has isolated task lists
